name: Waste
description: Common memory waste with known amounts (LeakyConsole --waste): duplicated strings, empty and oversized collections, large and sparse arrays, finalizable objects and pinned buffers, for the simple inspections.
notes: Counts mean: copies of a value (duplicate-strings), objects of a type (loh, finalizable) or rows naming objects of that type (large-arrays, sparse-arrays, empty- and oversized-collections); fragmentation counts pinned objects. Five more WasteFinalizable objects have finalization suppressed and must not be reported; WasteDoomed objects are dead and queued behind a finalizer that never returns (at least ten ready, the finalizer thread holds one); a dense WasteNode[] (32 filled slots) and a right-sized List<WasteItem> (4 of 4) must not be reported. The yyy... key is three copies of a 200,000-character string (the row shows its first 100 characters). One empty Dictionary was created empty, the other emptied by removals. Empty and oversized collections are the fixture's own, except HashSet<Int32>, which the runtime may also create (a lower bound).
